Comet Catcher, our start B8, Armada vehicles. His base is found: his Bot Lab (armlab) stands at his_lab (H1, beside spot_5), with an Overwatch (armhlt) at spot_10 (G2), a Beamer near spot_5 (G2), and flak and nanos at spot_12 (H2). Gauntlets (armguard, reach 1220) stand at spot_41 (F5) and spot_27 (F4): no constructor works within their reach.

commander: stays at the plant helping it. When an armpw or armflea party comes within its short walk of home or the plant, it attacks it. It never chases and never goes past spot_69 or spot_62.

plants: their lists, never idle. The Bot Lab, when it stands: armrectr only.

constructors: each on its own list; without one: the nearest free spot of spot_7, spot_14, spot_21, spot_23, spot_19, spot_26, spot_9, spot_47, spot_79, spot_75, then spot_46, spot_49, spot_32 once the Gauntlet at spot_41 is dead. Never to spot_29, spot_18, spot_27, spot_40, spot_41 or anything east of spot_20. Every lost extractor is rebuilt as soon as the raider is gone. Nobody stands or builds inside a plant's exit lane. A constructor with an enemy near it or under fire from something unseen drives back toward our army or a turret and goes back to work when it is clear.

group_L5 (our main army, in his base): it ignores every party behind it, never chases an armflea, armpw or armrectr, and never walks toward spot_40 or spot_27. It advances together along spot_17, spot_12, his_lab, spot_5, spot_10, spot_6, in that order, killing his Bot Lab (armlab), his constructors (armack) and every building there; its Mausers shell the Overwatch and Beamer from out of their reach while the Stouts and Bulls go in as one body. It goes to the next place the moment it reaches one. It never falls back while it outweighs what it meets, never walks home, never splits off detachments. His commander (armcom), when seen, is attacked by every soldier until it dies.

group_O8 (the second army): it advances along spot_49, spot_46, then spot_41 and spot_40, together, and kills the Gauntlet (armguard) and every turret standing at spot_41 and spot_40; then it advances to spot_55 and spot_53 and kills his extractors there; then it stands at spot_46 and kills any enemy party that comes to our extractors between spot_37, spot_44, spot_47, spot_49 and spot_46. It never chases an armflea. New groups from the plants join group_O8.

Rovers: scouts, left to themselves.
